question: Which of the following statements **correctly **describes a unique feature of the **Dumhal dance** of Kashmir?

options.text: It is performed by women during harvest festivals.
It is accompanied solely by string instruments and solo singing.
Only Wattal men perform it around a banner planted into the ground.
It allows spontaneous performance by any community on any occasion.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Only Wattal men perform it around a banner planted into the ground.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• **Dumhal** is a traditional folk dance of Jammu and Kashmir, performed exclusively by the **Wattal community men.**
 
• The performance begins with the participants planting a **banner or flag into the ground**, which is a unique feature of this dance form.
